trades.name: HVAC
trades.description: Heating, cooling, ventilation, boilers, heat pumps, water heaters and water treatment
stopRules: Any combustible gas reading above zero, or a gas smell reported by anyone
Ambient CO at or above the company CO stop level in living space
Cracked or rusted-through heat exchanger, flame rollout, or soot at the burner
Venting disconnected or blocked on a fuel-burning appliance
neverGuide: Opening gas valves, gas line work, or gas pressure adjustment
Refrigerant recovery, charging, or brazing on a charged system unless the technician confirms EPA 608 certification
Work on live circuits above 24 volts
Bypassing or jumping any safety switch, limit, or rollout switch
visibleHazards: combustibles stored next to a furnace or water heater
advisories: rust or standing water in a drain pan
verification: Run three full heating or cooling cycles
Temperature rise or split within the nameplate range
Flue CO and draft checked on fuel-burning equipment
No error codes on the control board after the last cycle
Thermostat calls and stops correctly

trades.name: Electrical
trades.description: Residential and light commercial electrical service, panels, circuits, fixtures, EV chargers, generators

preWorkReadings.label: Circuit verified dead with a tested meter (live-dead-live)
preWorkReadings.requiredWhen: any work inside a panel, box, or fixture

stopRules: Burning smell, smoke, or heat at a panel, outlet, or wire
Water in or on a panel or energized equipment
Aluminum branch wiring with signs of overheating
Any shock or tingle reported by the technician or customer
neverGuide: Work on energized conductors or inside an energized panel
Removing a panel dead front without the technician confirming PPE and training
Service entrance, meter, or utility-side work
Defeating breakers, GFCI or AFCI protection
visibleHazards: double-tapped or oversized breakers with heat marks
advisories: missing knockouts or open holes in a panel
extension cords used as permanent wiring
verification: Circuit tested under load after the repair
GFCI and AFCI devices tested where installed
Torque on terminations per manufacturer spec
Panel directory updated
Covers and dead front reinstalled

trades.name: Plumbing
trades.description: Water supply, drains, fixtures, water heaters, sump pumps, gas piping where licensed

preWorkReadings.label: Combustible gas detector
preWorkReadings.requiredWhen: gas water heater or gas piping

stopRules: Any gas smell or detector reading above zero
Sewage backup with exposure risk without PPE
Water near energized electrical equipment
Signs of a failing water heater relief valve or tank bulge
neverGuide: Gas piping work unless the technician confirms a gas license
Disabling a temperature and pressure relief valve
Work on a pressurized line without the shutoff confirmed closed
visibleHazards: water on or near electrical parts
active leak onto a ceiling or panel
corroded or bulging water heater tank
advisories: corroded fittings or green crusting on copper
no drain pan under a water heater
verification: Pressure test or visual leak check after 10 minutes
Fixtures run hot and cold, drains clear
Water heater relief valve discharge pipe in place
Work area dry

trades.name: Roofing
trades.description: Roof inspection, leak repair, shingles, flat roofs, flashing, gutters
stopRules: No fall protection on a roof above 6 feet
Wet, icy, or frost-covered roof surface
Wind strong enough to move materials
Soft or sagging decking underfoot
Overhead power lines within 10 feet of the work area
neverGuide: Any roof work without fall protection
Work near overhead power lines
Structural repairs to rafters or trusses without a supervisor
visibleHazards: overhead power lines near the work area
verification: Photos of every repaired area
Flashing sealed and fastened
Debris and nails cleaned from the ground
Water test when the customer allows

trades.name: Cleaning
trades.description: Residential and commercial cleaning, deep cleaning, carpets, windows, post-construction
stopRules: Visible mold larger than about 10 square feet
Sharps, needles, or biohazard material
Suspected asbestos material that is damaged or friable
Chemical odor or symptoms from mixing products
neverGuide: Mixing bleach with ammonia or acids
Biohazard cleanup without the right training and PPE
Working on ladders above 6 feet without a second person
advisories: surfaces that need a specialty cleaner
damaged finishes to note before cleaning
items to move with customer permission
verification: Walkthrough with the customer room by room
Photos of finished areas
All products and equipment removed
Customer sign-off on any noted pre-existing damage

trades.name: Auto mechanic
trades.description: Mobile and shop auto repair, diagnostics, brakes, batteries, maintenance

preWorkReadings.label: Vehicle secured (park, brake, chocks, jack stands)
preWorkReadings.requiredWhen: any work under or lifting the vehicle

preWorkReadings.label: Hybrid or EV high-voltage system present

stopRules: Working under a vehicle supported only by a jack
Fuel leak or strong fuel smell
Hybrid or EV orange high-voltage cables involved without HV training
Airbag components involved without disarming per manufacturer procedure
neverGuide: Work on hybrid or EV high-voltage components unless the technician confirms HV training
Airbag or SRS work without manufacturer procedure
Working under a vehicle without jack stands
visibleHazards: vehicle on a jack without stands
advisories: worn brake pads or scored rotors
verification: No warning lights after the repair
Torque on wheels and fasteners to spec
Fluid levels checked
Test drive or function test when appropriate

trades.name: Appliance repair
trades.description: Washers, dryers, refrigerators, ovens, ranges, dishwashers
stopRules: Gas smell or detector reading above zero
Burn marks or melted wiring inside the appliance
Dryer vent clogged with lint near a heat source
neverGuide: Gas line work unless licensed
Live testing inside an appliance without the technician confirming training
Bypassing door switches or thermal fuses
visibleHazards: water under an appliance near outlets
advisories: missing anti-tip bracket on a range
verification: Full cycle run
No error codes
No leaks after the cycle
Appliance leveled and anti-tip in place

trades.name: General field service
trades.description: Handyman work and any trade without a specific profile
stopRules: Any gas smell, smoke, or burning smell
Exposed live wiring
Unstable ladder or work surface
Suspected asbestos or lead paint being disturbed
neverGuide: Gas, electrical, or plumbing work that requires a license the technician does not hold
Structural changes to load-bearing walls
visibleHazards: damaged materials that may contain asbestos
verification: Customer walkthrough
Photos of finished work
Work area clean
